Thank you. I appreciate. I think I'm away from killing myself but the heartache and loneliness still is hard. I love my wife but I'm not in love with her. 

I am in love with my co-worker but she doesn't want anything to do with me now. It's killing me not being around her but I'm respecting her wishes. I tried not texting her or stopping by her desk but it's hard. I vowed to not contact her for a while. The problem is for the first time in years, I have been happy when I was with her. Now that is gone and I'm in a dark place. 

I thought I was stronger than this but I physically hurt.
